title: Fix docs build: escape MDX table expressions and flatten meta.json structure
body:
CI build failed on main with MDX parsing errors and invalid meta.json schema.

## Changes

**MDX syntax fix** (`ai-development-guide.mdx`)
- Wrapped bare `{}` in table cells with backticks to prevent JSX interpretation
- Affected 6 cells in field types table (lookup, master_detail, avatar, image, file, json)

```diff
-| `lookup` | Lookup relationship | { id: "123", name: "..." } |
+| `lookup` | Lookup relationship | `{ id: "123", name: "..." }` |
```

**meta.json structure fix** (`developers/meta.json`)
- Removed unsupported nested object in pages array
- Flattened AI pages into top-level array after separator

```diff
  "pages": [
    "cli-tools",
    "---",
-   {
-     "title": "🤖 AI-Driven Development",
-     "pages": ["ai-development-guide", "ai-quick-reference", "ai-erp-tutorial"]
-   }
+   "ai-development-guide",
+   "ai-quick-reference",
+   "ai-erp-tutorial"
  ]
```
